notes: Sabotrack: saboteurs now sabotage from a big map (click the minimap or the 🗺️ Sabotage button): ⚡ over Electrical cuts the lights, ☢️ over the Control Room starts a meltdown, and you can pick up to 3 single gates to shut for 10 seconds, then a 30-second cooldown. Nobody can see through a shut gate, from either side. Also: hold WASD or the arrow keys to walk, and the Use button is now a big circle.
